paras: JPMorgan brought <g>JPM Coin (JPMD)</g> to Ethereum for its institutional clients on Monday.
Each token is a dollar <u>held in a JPMorgan account</u>, redeemable any time. It launched on Base in November 2025 and can now move between Base and Ethereum.
Transfers settle in seconds, any day of the week. A bank wire only moves on business days.
slides.source: JPMorgan / Kinexys via The Block, Decrypt, CoinDesk

paras: This isn't a stablecoin. A stablecoin is backed by reserves a company holds elsewhere. JPMD <g>is the bank deposit itself</g>, and JPMorgan says deposit tokens can pay interest.
<r>You can't buy it</r>: only vetted institutions can hold it, and it's not on exchanges.
<u>"Tokenized financial infrastructure is no longer theoretical," says Kinexys Labs head Emma Landriault.</u>
